text: @aleabitoreddit Hi @aleabitoreddit How are you? Do you think this sell-off is a buying opportunity or is a bigger crash coming? Have you been adding anything to your portfolio lately?

Clearly a macro related drop after CPI numbers came out today and further US rate hike anticipation. Since $KOSPI, $SPY, and Nikkei ended up plummeting. 

There's too many potential second/third order effects that's hard to map due if $CRWV goes down or frontier labs struggle (given contractual obligations).  

Rate hikes understandably amplifies a lot of those fears. But I do think everything getting sold off together presents opportunities. 

If $LITE has take/pay contracts + sold out until 2029 for lasers and is being financed by hyperscalers for 2031 demand. 

The demand visibility + financing (with counterparties like $MSFT or $AMZN) are too solid that I wouldn't bunch companies in the optical sector together (that already have cash on hand via ATMs or private placement). 

With a neocloud that requires billions in future toxic financing in high rate environments. 

I think markets will eventually distinguish nuances from actual profitability, financing, and long term demand sustainability rather than just treating everything as one "bubble".

$TSM released earnings today. I was more curious about commentary given recent the market panic.

For analyst Q&A rounds: 

Q: Citi explicitly challenged TSMC on AI financing, HBM, CoWoS, lasers and the risk of overbuilding capacity 

A: $TSM assessed CSP capex, DC construction conditions, customer financial conditions, and supply of critical components. 

Management's conclusion is still that "demand exceeds supply". As well as that AI accelerator revenue growth could exceed its previous 50%+ CAGR projection through 2029.

This is a more meaningful statement since it addresses some concerns regarding recent selloff. 

Q: JPM asked if wafer supply could be tighter in 2027 than in 2026 (demand visibility)

A: Wei (Chairman/CEO) stated $TSM even sends staff to verify DC construction progress on site. And after assessing all the factors, TSMC believes gap between supply and demand remains substantial.  

It could not determine whether the extent of the gap given customers continues to increase demand. 

Q: On pricing power:

A: Wei responded that there is "no ceiling on TSMC's profitability" but that profits will not surge dramatically overnight.

(Source: NextApple, Taiwanese press)

Regarding earnings, very strong: as usual 

- TSMC record profits of $23.6B (68% Y/Y growth), and revenue jumping to $46.72B, beating expectations.

- Q4 Guidance was $52.3-$54.3B revenue off 65-67% gross margins.

TLDR:

- No signs of any slowdown or collapse as AI demand far exceeds supply for foreseeable future. $TSM is probably the fundamental proxy/canary to how the overall AI semi trade is doing. 

- On financing concerns and fear of overcapacity showing up in semiconductor demand: 

$TSM specifically examined the risks investors are concerned about now and assessment still points to unmet demand. 

During the Q&A session, Wei said AI demand was "very, extremely strong," with absolutely no signs of slowing.

Underlying AI semi supply chain growth is healthier than recent market panic suggest.

When people ask me about how colleges are responding to AI, I often say that universities are in crisis. But also that universities have always been in a crisis.

quoted_tweet.author: Misha Teplitskiy | Science of Science
quoted_tweet.text:
Ok so this book WAS very fun. Big picture takeaways:

- universities have always had an unstable business model, which is constantly evolving. The current bundle of education and research need not last forever either.

- all the culture war stuff we're debating now has been there for literally 800 years. Students have always partied and had sex and wanted to overthrow authority and cross dress and haze each other, and parents and governments have always attempted to exert control, and the relative power of each has oscillated. Colleges used to have their own jails! U of Uppsala executed a student via DEATH PENALTY as late as 1770s!

- the health of the industry has oscillated a ton, with European enrollments dropping by as much as half in certain decades and centuries.

- realistically, the best way to protect universities from being defunded is for all professors to work at least partially on weapons systems

- the book (and others on this topic) has made it increasingly annoying to listen to non-historian analysts comment on the academic industry, because seemingly none of them seem to be aware that basically none of the phenomena they are analyzing are new.

The book is not perfect. It's ostensibly a history told via architecture, but that connection is meh. And there's not an attempt to give a proper socio-economic analysis of the evolution of universities, it reads more as a collection of facts.

But the facts are awesome, so I highly recommend!

quoted_tweet.text:
有心理问题的人开始创业后，智商会极速下降

比如绝大多数人眼中的找对标，就是找一个赚钱的人，然后对标这个赚钱的人身上最菜的那一部分

一说搞情感，集体全去对标曲曲

曲曲的直播能力 TA 不对标，曲曲的几百万粉丝 TA 也不对标。就只对标 “讲情感” 这仨字 —— 那确实人人都能讲两句

如果我们把赚钱分为「内容流量」和「产品转化」两部分，99% 的人找对标的做法分为以下两种：

1️⃣ 找一个内容流量做得特别好的人，然后对标这个人的变现产品 ——  比如一个千万粉丝大博主做直播带货，那我也做直播带货。至于这个人有 1000 万粉丝，我只有一千粉丝，这个事儿我避而不谈

2️⃣ 找一个产品落地有壁垒的人，然后对标这个人的内容流量 —— 我每次直播连线到所谓「低粉高变现」的业务（给人咨询解决心态问题的），几百粉丝月入几万，大家就扎堆问这个人账号是啥

潜台词是找到一批人傻钱多的买家就行了。至于人家真能用一个小时解决别人心态问题的强交付能力，避而不谈

「低粉高变现」这五个字里面，就只对标「低粉」这俩字

----

对标一个业务，要连流量带产品一起去对标，这个事儿我从 2024 年说到现在，你说这个事情很高深，大家理解不了吗？绝对不可能的

那为什么一到自己身上，一创业后，大家的智商就集体崩塌了呢？ —— 因为你想在不难受、不改变的情况下实现结果

还是以对标百万博主为例。自打一开始，你就没准备好承担涨粉百万的压力

所以你只能看得见「百万博主的变现手段」，「百万博主的粉丝量」你是完完全全看不见的，鸵鸟一头扎进沙土里 —— 你别跟我讲，我不听我不听

智商越高的人，越难劝得动，聪明人最擅长自圆其说

我说百万粉以上的不要对标，他说：你不试试怎么知道呢
我说他们的变现是基于人脉的，他说：我用你的 Skill 教我怎么搞人脉

那我只能说：人各有命

----

我现在算是做商业博主，两年零半个月，这两年我就是一直在看同一个剧本：

一群聪明人因为不敢直视问题本身，不用他们的认知和智力解决问题，反而用他们的智力来证明：为什么做错事是合理的

对标曲曲、对标谢胜子、对标我 …… 都是如此

「为什么不能对标 dontbesilent」这个问题我回答不了，提问的人太聪明，心理问题也太严重

周濂说：你永远无法叫醒一个装睡的人

更何况是一个聪明的装睡的人
